sections.Profile:
The "Harvest Moon" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Party, Good Times, Singing, Wood Rail, Dancing, Nightlife, Original Theme, Music
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Harry Mabs
- Art: Roy Parker
